rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when something is likely or expected to happen or become.

example.english: As a prospective student, I have a good chance of getting into this university.
example.traditional: 我有機會考入呢間大學。
example.jyutping: ngo5 jau5 gei1 wui6 haau2 jap6 ne1 gaan1 daai6 hok6

rows.note: Use this before a status or role for someone expected soon to become that thing, such as a prospective bride or student.

example.english: They are the prospective manager of our company and will be promoted soon.
example.traditional: 佢係我哋公司嘅準經理，遲啲就會升職。
example.jyutping: keoi5 hai6 ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 ge3 zeon2 ging1 lei5 ci4 di1 zau6 wui5 sing1 zik1

rows.note: Use this for a person or thing that belongs to the future or is forthcoming, rather than to stress likelihood.

example.english: My prospective job may not be the same as the one I have now.
example.traditional: 我將來嘅工作未必同而家做開嘅一樣。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zoeng1 loi4 ge3 gung1 zok3 mei6 bit1 tung4 ji4 gaa1 zou6 hoi1 ge3 jat1 joeng6
